description.value: Locality Brewing is a family-owned farm brewery on MacInnes Farms in North Langley where barley and hops are grown, malted, and brewed entirely on-site, delivering a genuine field-to-glass experience in the Fraser Valley. The outdoor-only taproom features a picnic area and hiking trails set within a working farm, making it a scenic and relaxed destination well suited to touring cyclists. An on-site food vendor (Stampede Burger) serves burgers and sides alongside the locally crafted farmhouse beers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Locality Brewing is an active farm brewery taproom at 7111 252 St, Langley, BC with phone (604) 371-1380 and email events@localitybrewing.ca; OSM's outdoor_seating=only aligns with the website's description of an exclusively outdoor picnic taproom experience on a working farm. No explicit bike parking, washroom, or water refill amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website; however, vegetarian options (Black Bean Burger, Salad) and a Keto option are confirmed via the on-site Stampede Burger taproom menu. OSM opening hours differ notably from the website's current posted hours, which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM opening hours (Mo-We 15:30-20:00; Th,Su 12:00-20:00; Fr-Sa 12:00-21:00) differ significantly from the website's current posted hours (Wed-Sun 12:00 PM - 10:00 PM); website is more authoritative.
